input.quote: 10.5 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: Section 10.5 selects New York law, which matches our preferred governing law. However, the Agreement contains no forum, venue or dispute-resolution provision anywhere (no arbitration clause either), so disputes could be litigated in any jurisdiction, including HDI's home state of New Jersey. That leaves the venue element of both the preferred and fallback checklists unmet on a material term. We therefore add a single sentence conferring exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County over the merits, preserving only temporary injunctive relief elsewhere, and leave the existing governing-law wording untouched.

ops.text: Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York over the merits of any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, provided that either Party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction.
